## Definition and classification
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_cities_in_China_by_population&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Definition and classification")]
According to the [administrative divisions of China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Administrative_divisions_of_China "Administrative divisions of China"), there are three major levels of cities, namely [direct-administered municipalities](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Direct-administered_municipalities_of_China "Direct-administered municipalities of China") (直辖市[prefecture-level cities](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prefecture-level_city "Prefecture-level city") (地级市[county-level cities](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/County-level_city "County-level city") (县级市[special administrative regions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special_administrative_regions_of_China "Special administrative regions of China") (特别行政区[Hong Kong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hong_Kong "Hong Kong") and [Macau](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Macau "Macau") as well as the [cities](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special_municipality_\(Taiwan\) "Special municipality \(Taiwan\)") controlled by the [Republic of China](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taiwan "Taiwan"). Prefecture-level cities nearly always contain multiple [counties](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Counties_of_China "Counties of China") (县[county-level cities](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/County-level_city "County-level city"), and other such sub-divisions. 
Municipalities and prefecture-level cities are not each a 'city' in the strictest sense of the term, but are instead an administrative unit typically comprising both the [urban core](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urban_area "Urban area") (_a city in the strict sense_) and surrounding [rural](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rural_area "Rural area") or less-urbanized areas.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cities_in_China_by_population#cite_note-13) The term "市区 _shì qū_ ; "urban area") is used to distinguish a city's actual urban center from its administratively defined boundaries. However, even this term often encompasses large suburban regions, often greater than 3,000 square kilometres (1,000 sq mi), or sometimes only the urban core, whereas the agglomeration overtakes the city limits. Thus, the "urban core" would be roughly comparable to the American term "city limit", and the "shì qū", or "urban area", would be roughly comparable to a city's "metropolitan area." The municipality is a political designation defining regions under control of a municipal government, which has no comparable designation in America.
While in 2013, [Chongqing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chongqing "Chongqing") had the largest population total of any special municipality, 28 million, only 4.5 million of the people were in the actual Chongqing urban area, with the rest of the population in suburban and rural areas.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cities_in_China_by_population#cite_note-14)
## List of major cities by population
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_cities_in_China_by_population&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: List of major cities by population")]
The list contains all the cities with the administrative designation of "[national central city](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_central_city "National central city")" (国家中心城市[sub-provincial city](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sub-provincial_division#Sub-provincial_municipalities "Sub-provincial division")" (副省级城市[cities with independent planning status](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_capitals_in_China#List_of_the_Cities_with_Independent_Planning_Status "List of capitals in China")" (计划单列市[provincial capital cities](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_capitals_in_China "List of capitals in China")" (省会城市[special economic zones](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special_economic_zones_of_China "Special economic zones of China")" (经济特区城市[open coastal cities](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special_economic_zones_of_China#List_of_the_SEZs_and_Open_Coastal_Cities "Special economic zones of China")" (沿海开放城市地级市[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cities_in_China_by_population#cite_note-15) as well as other cities that have a population of over 1 million.
This list defines a city's population as the population of a city's urban population, rather than the entire population of its municipal boundaries.
